Similar to the [[Force cloak]] and [[Force stealth]] abilities, conjuring a '''spell of concealment''' through [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]] allowed the caster to hide or cloak the presence of one or multiple individuals. [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] used it to sneak up behind and [[Shiak|impale]] the [[Echani/Legends|Echani]] [[Jedi Weapon Master|weapons]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Raskta Lsu]]. She also used it to cloak her [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] and herself while hiding in a secret underground compartment in [[Caleb]]'s house. This in conjunction with the [[Summon fear|insanity spell]] fooled the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] into thinking her cousin [[Darovit]] was the last surviving [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]].
